summary: Source-only diagnostics mining found a non-duplicate proof-surface integrity gap. PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.capture() treats an enabled diagnostics tree as valid when diagnosticInstanceCount is merely positive; runToggleEvidence() likewise proves enabled/disabled lifecycle and no physical-lab drift but does not fail closed on missing, duplicated, wrong-type, misbound, or content-drifted per-entity BillboardGui/TextLabel readouts after enable(). The manual diagnostics contract requires the viewport readout to expose and agree on stable WorldEntityId, recipe identity, effective fidelity, recipe fingerprint and repro key. A readout can therefore be removed or altered after construction while capture/evidence still reports an enabled diagnostics surface and the later disable cycle cleans it up successfully. This is distinct from evt-20260811-085430-k8v2q6m4-diagnostics-instance-binding, which concerns whether the enumerated physical representation is the runtime-owned Instance. Recommended bounded closure after current #327/#333 integration: validate the diagnostics proof tree semantically against the planned entity set (exact one owned billboard+label per expected representation, Adornee bound to that representation, displayed/captured tuple derived from canonical WorldEntityId/recipeKey/fidelity/fingerprint/repro), reject missing/extra/misbound/content-drifted readouts in capture/evidence, and add source regressions that mutate/remove/misbind a readout after enable. No Studio/viewport PASS is claimed by this finding.
